title: The prize wall is EXACTLY where the binomial budget-vs-supply inequality C(2N,r)<r*2^r*C(N,r) flips
evidence: Three exact probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/ (C007_crossover.py exact-int, C007_wall_location.py + C007_epsfeas.py log2-space for prize n=2^30). (1) The crossover r* (smallest r with budget C(n,r)/r >= supply 2^r*C(n/2,r)) is reproduced EXACTLY: r*=4,7,11,17,27,41,62,93,138,204 for n=8..4096 -- matches the connection record. The choose_bulk Lean lemma (C(2N,r)<r*2^r*C(N,r) for r<=sqrt(N)) is real and axiom-clean. THAT MUCH IS PROVEN. (2) But r*/n is NOT ~0.3: it DROPS monotonically 0.500,0.438,0.344,0.266,0.211,0.160,0.121,0.091,0.067,0.050 and ->0 as n->inf; the '0.27-0.34 n band' is a small-n (n=32,64) artifact. At prize n=2^30, r*=160422 so r*/n ~ 1.5e-4. (3) 'crossover sits inside beyond-Johnson window' is VACUOUS: with rate rho=(r-1)/n the entire pin family delta*=1-r/n is beyond-Johnson from r=2 up and never leaves the window (r_leave=None for all n) -- being in-window distinguishes nothing. (4) DECISIVE: the crossover marks budget<antipodal-SUPPLY, NOT budget<=eps*=2^-128. The all-witness budget C(n,r)/r is monotone INCREASING in r, so its minimum on the pin range is at r=2: lg(budget(2)/p)=(2-beta)mu-2 = -62 (beta=4) or -92 (beta=5) at mu=30 -- NEVER <= -128. Reaching 2^-128 needs (beta-2)mu>=126 i.e. beta>=6.2, outside the prize beta~4-5. So the lower-half budget bound is too weak by 2^36..2^66 at the prize point FOR EVERY r; the crossover r* is irrelevant to eps*. The concrete in-tree pin deltaStar_pin_concrete_F4129 confirms this: it pins at eps*=14/4129=2^-8.2, ~2^120 above the prize eps*.
honest_note: The PROVEN part is genuine and valuable as modularity: choose_bulk and the crossover band are exact, and kkh26_deltaStar_pin_lowdegree really does pin delta*=1-r/2^mu UNCONDITIONALLY for r<=sqrt(n) at eps*=budget/p. What is REFUTED is only the headline equation 'prize wall = crossover'. The crossover governs budget-vs-SUPPLY; the prize governs budget-vs-2^-128, a strictly stronger and disjoint constraint that the all-witness (face-2, O(n)/q ~ poly(n)/q) budget never meets in the prize regime. So C007 relocates a DIFFERENT wall (the antipodal-supply crossover) onto a finite binomial inequality -- a real, decidable, proven object -- but it is not the prize/BGK wall. The genuine prize core (BGK sqrt-cancellation for thin mu_n at eps*=2^-128) is untouched; this welds back to wall W-BGK / the face-2 combinatorial-budget weakness. Probe is exact integer (n<=4096) and lgamma log2-space (n=2^30); no sampling. Should be noted in DISPROOF_LOG as 'crossover != prize-eps* wall'.
wall: W-BGK (and the face-2 all-witness combinatorial-budget weakness: budget/p ~ poly(n)/q is silent at eps*=2^-128 for every r when beta<6.2)
